messages.content: 你能先幫我找一個素食，主菜的食譜嗎？並且能在30分鐘內準備好嗎？之後，能否請你找出重力的科學發現的詳細資料，使用預設的方法？完成後，我也想知道使用同樣方法發現希格斯玻色子的相關資料。最後，能否幫我找一個能在45分鐘內準備的無麩質甜點食譜？

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1. Find a vegetarian main course recipe that can be prepared in 30 minutes. Use the find_recipe function.

2. Retrieve details of the scientific discovery "Gravity" using default method. Use science_history_get_discovery_details.

3. Retrieve details of the discovery "Higgs boson" using same method.

4. Find a gluten-free dessert recipe that can be prepared in 45 minutes. Use find_recipe.

We need to call the functions accordingly. The user wants all four tasks. We'll call find_recipe twice, and science_history_get_discovery_details twice.

We need to output the results. The function calls should be separate. We'll produce JSON calls. The assistant should call the functions in order. We'll produce the function calls and then the final answer.

We need to use the function calls. The user wants the recipe and discovery details. We'll call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions: "vegetarian", recipe_type: "main course", time: 30. Then call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery: "Gravity". Then call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery: "Higgs boson". Then call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions: "gluten free", recipe_type: "dessert", time: 45.

We need to output the function calls. The assistant should not provide additional text before calling the function. According to guidelines, we should call the function. We'll do them sequentially. We'll produce the function calls.
